plan.source: Huluxinoag (King of the Murkmire): the only candidate with a Hist, the place's heart and the quest's object, with its roots and glands in a living and a dead state (the dead state serves the Take and Give endings), platforms, mud-hut walkways, a waterside landing and boats. Ree-An-Wo (palisaded stockade hamlet, no Hist) already serves Reed-Sill Weir and Karsh-Naal Camp and lends only its tents here; argoniaworld-29-29 (no camp) and Black Rose (marble arches) were rejected on looking. No other place is laid from Huluxinoag's exterior (Tailfall Mound takes only its Roots room), so no differs entry is owed. Laid turned 80 degrees at the source's own height so its waterfront wraps our creek head.
